task.title: Enlarge product-card viewports and simplify their information areas
task.input: The existing ProductGallery/Scene, GET /api/models and the layout in section 11
task.output: Adaptive large 560px cards and separate model/action areas
task.accept: 1) Entry: the home-page products-link leads to /[locale]/products; the data sources are GET /api/models and actual model URLs; PC cards have a 560px minimum and viewport clamp(360px,28vw,440px), without overflow at width 390; names, necessary specifications and inquiry controls must be distinguishable, and actions must remain after repeated descriptions are removed (E-104). 2) Titles and buttons must have independent links; dragging inside the Canvas must neither navigate nor submit; the list category-link must enter the existing /[locale]/products/[slug] under the publication switch and return to the 3D catalog, without expanding it into a complete PDP (E-97).
